lines.zh: 我游过末地的虚空，像一块石头。
lines.en: I cross the End void like a piece of stone.

lines.zh: 身体是岩石，游起来却轻。
lines.en: My body is rock, yet I swim lightly.

lines.zh: 橙色的苔藓在水里飘。
lines.en: Orange moss trails behind me in the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着虚空边缘，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I hug the void's edge and move slowly.

lines.zh: 三条五条一起，像落了石。
lines.en: Three or five of us come down like fallen stones.

lines.zh: 末地石的味道，我熟悉。
lines.en: I know the taste of End stone well.

lines.zh: 鳍很硬，划水像凿石头。
lines.en: My fins are stiff, cutting water like chisels.

lines.zh: 你看见影子，就看见我。
lines.en: If you see a shadow, you have seen me.

lines.zh: 我沉下去很快，游上来很慢。
lines.en: I sink fast and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 四十厘米的岩块，在暗里漂。
lines.en: Forty centimeters of rock drifts in the dark.

lines.zh: 苔藓吸了水，颜色更深。
lines.en: The moss soaks up water and darkens.

lines.zh: 同伴在前面，我跟着。
lines.en: My companions are ahead, and I follow.

lines.zh: 虚空的水没有波浪，只有我。
lines.en: Void water has no waves, only me.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，石头本来就这样。
lines.en: I don't swim fast; stone never does.

lines.zh: 苔藓在水里飘，像一层薄绒。
lines.en: The moss drifts in the water like thin felt.

lines.zh: 我翻过末地石的棱，往下滑。
lines.en: I tip over an end stone ridge and slide down.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我只挪开半尺。
lines.en: One flick of my tail moves me barely half a block.

lines.zh: 队伍散了又聚，我还在中间。
lines.en: The school scatters and gathers; I stay in the middle.

lines.zh: 我悬在末地的水面上，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang on the End's water without moving.

lines.zh: 苔藓在水里慢慢漂，很安静。
lines.en: The moss drifts slowly; it is quiet.

lines.zh: 一块会呼吸的石头，就是这样。
lines.en: This is what a breathing stone looks like.

lines.zh: 我身上的橙，在暗里很显眼。
lines.en: The orange on me stands out in the dark.

lines.zh: 几十条同类，散在虚空里。
lines.en: Dozens of my kind drift through the void.

lines.zh: 水流过石缝，发出细响。
lines.en: Water runs through my stone cracks with a whisper.

lines.zh: 我没有心跳，只有水压。
lines.en: I have no heartbeat, only water pressure.

lines.zh: 浮在这里，比游更省力。
lines.en: Floating here costs less than swimming.

lines.zh: 末地的天是黑的，水也黑。
lines.en: The End sky is black, and so is the water.

lines.zh: 我身上的苔藓，谁都摘不走。
lines.en: No one can pick the moss off me.

lines.zh: 五点生命，够撑过这片虚空。
lines.en: Five points of health to weather this void.

lines.zh: 我不怕暗，暗里石头不说话。
lines.en: I fear no dark; stone stays silent in it.

lines.zh: 等同伴游过，我再动。
lines.en: I wait for companions to pass, then move.

lines.zh: 慢慢沉，慢慢浮，一天就过去了。
lines.en: Sink slowly, rise slowly, and the day is gone.

lines.zh: 你从末地门进来，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you come in through the End portal.

lines.zh: 橙苔在水里一晃，你才认出我。
lines.en: Only when my orange moss sways do you see me.

lines.zh: 你以为那是石头？
lines.en: You thought I was just stone?

lines.zh: 别用镐敲我，我不是矿。
lines.en: Don't tap me with a pickaxe; I'm not ore.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，其实看不清。
lines.en: I stare at you, though I barely see.

lines.zh: 你的灯照过来，苔藓亮了。
lines.en: Your light falls on me and the moss glows.

lines.zh: 我这样的鱼，末地到处都有。
lines.en: Fish like me are everywhere in the End.

lines.zh: 你手上的桶，让我有点好奇。
lines.en: That bucket in your hand makes me curious.

lines.zh: 同类都在远处，别惊动它们。
lines.en: My companions are far off; don't disturb them.

lines.zh: 看得出来你在算我的长度。
lines.en: I can tell you're estimating my length.

lines.zh: 敲上来，碎屑掉进水里。
lines.en: A hit lands, and chips drop into the water.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，苔藓翻了起来。
lines.en: My shell cracked, and the moss peeled up.

lines.zh: 石头也会疼，只是叫不出声。
lines.en: Stone feels pain too; it just cannot cry out.

lines.zh: 碎屑沉下去，我跟着沉。
lines.en: The chips sink, and I sink with them.

lines.zh: 别敲第二下，我游不快。
lines.en: Do not strike twice; I cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 水里的橙色淡了一片。
lines.en: A patch of orange fades in the water.

lines.zh: 我缩进岩缝，背对着你。
lines.en: I shrink into a rock crevice, my back to you.

lines.zh: 这一块崩了，我得慢慢长回来。
lines.en: A piece broke off; I must grow it back slowly.

lines.zh: 同伴散了，我落在后面。
lines.en: The school scattered, and I fell behind.

lines.zh: 我咬着水，把疼咽下去。
lines.en: I bite the water and swallow the ache.

lines.zh: 你撒下的鱼饵，落在石头缝里。
lines.en: Your bait lands in a crack between stones.

lines.zh: 苔藓底下有点吃的，我闻到了。
lines.en: Something edible under the moss; I smell it.

lines.zh: 水里飘来一股味，不坏。
lines.en: A smell drifts through the water, not bad.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠过去，石头不该急。
lines.en: I drift closer slowly; stone shouldn't hurry.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，能让苔藓变亮。
lines.en: Whatever you hold makes my moss brighten.

lines.zh: 同伴都围过来了，我也去。
lines.en: My companions are gathering, so I go too.

lines.zh: 让我咬一下，就一下。
lines.en: Let me have one bite, just one.

lines.zh: 末地很少有这么香的东西。
lines.en: The End rarely offers anything this fragrant.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，石头也能嚼。
lines.en: I'm not picky; I can chew stone.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就当你在让食。
lines.en: Step back, and I'll take it as an invitation.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，手背蹭了一手苔。
lines.en: You bump me and get moss on your knuckles.

lines.zh: 我是石头，撞我不划算。
lines.en: I am stone; bumping me isn't wise.

lines.zh: 水下闷闷的一声，你退了。
lines.en: A dull thud underwater, and you back off.

lines.zh: 别推，我这一块很重。
lines.en: Don't push; this block of me is heavy.

lines.zh: 半格的碰撞箱，也能挡住人。
lines.en: Half a block of hitbox still blocks a person.

lines.zh: 你一挤，苔藓掉了一小片。
lines.en: You squeeze past and a bit of moss falls off.

lines.zh: 我被撞得下沉，过会儿才浮起。
lines.en: The bump sinks me; I rise again later.

lines.zh: 撞开的涟漪，惊散了同伴。
lines.en: The ripples scattered my companions.

lines.zh: 你的剑碰到我，响得像敲石。
lines.en: Your sword strikes me, ringing like stone.

lines.zh: 再碰一次，我就当你要带我走。
lines.en: Touch me again and I'll think you're taking me.

lines.zh: 三条五条一起，总有看对眼的。
lines.en: Among three or five, someone always catches my eye.

lines.zh: 我的苔藓颜色最深，它看见了。
lines.en: My moss is the deepest orange; it noticed.

lines.zh: 两条岩鱼并排沉进虚空。
lines.en: Two rockfish sink into the void side by side.

lines.zh: 石头和石头靠一靠，就算成家。
lines.en: Stone leaning on stone counts as a home.

lines.zh: 它绕着我转，水纹很圆。
lines.en: It circles me, and the ripples turn round.

lines.zh: 同伴都在看，我不着急。
lines.en: My companions are watching; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 橙色挨着橙色，很像岩层。
lines.en: Orange against orange, like layers of rock.

lines.zh: 我们一起游，方向不必一致。
lines.en: We swim together, though not in one direction.

lines.zh: 繁殖在末地，没什么仪式。
lines.en: Spawning in the End involves no ceremony.

lines.zh: 它先沉下去，我跟在后面。
lines.en: It sinks first, and I follow behind.

lines.zh: 桶里有点挤，但我能忍。
lines.en: The bucket is cramped, but I can bear it.

lines.zh: 我比看起来重，提稳了。
lines.en: I'm heavier than I look; lift carefully.

lines.zh: 苔藓碰到桶壁，蹭掉一点。
lines.en: My moss scrapes the bucket wall a little.

lines.zh: 你要带我出末地？
lines.en: You're taking me out of the End?

lines.zh: 石头离开虚空，会变冷。
lines.en: Stone away from the void grows cold.

lines.zh: 桶底没水，我待不久。
lines.en: No water in the bucket; I won't last.

lines.zh: 别晃，我的苔藓会掉光。
lines.en: Don't shake it or my moss will fall off.

lines.zh: 提着我走，步子放轻。
lines.en: Carry me along, and keep your steps light.

lines.zh: 放回水里，我还能游。
lines.en: Put me back in water and I can still swim.

lines.zh: 装桶带走，也算一种运气。
lines.en: Bucketing me away counts as a bit of luck.

lines.zh: 你手上的饵动了，我盯上了。
lines.en: The bait in your hand moved; I'm watching it.

lines.zh: 同类都往一个方向，我也去。
lines.en: My companions all head one way, so I go too.

lines.zh: 水里那点碎屑，归我了。
lines.en: Those crumbs in the water are mine.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我追味道。
lines.en: I don't chase people; I chase smells.

lines.zh: 谁先动，谁就是我要的。
lines.en: Whoever moves first is what I want.

lines.zh: 末地的东西都慢，我等得起。
lines.en: Everything in the End is slow; I can wait.

lines.zh: 那群同伴已经围上去了。
lines.en: The group has already closed in on it.

lines.zh: 我咬住就不放，石头很倔。
lines.en: Once I bite, I hold; stone is stubborn.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里乱晃。
lines.en: Don't dangle your hand in the water.

lines.zh: 目标不大，但够一群分。
lines.en: The target is small but enough for a group.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，从下面靠近。
lines.en: I sink and approach from below.

lines.zh: 苔藓挡着，你看不出我在动。
lines.en: The moss hides me; you can't see me move.

lines.zh: 同伴散开，我从另一边来。
lines.en: My companions spread out; I come from the other side.

lines.zh: 慢一点，石头不必着急。
lines.en: Slower; stone has no reason to hurry.

lines.zh: 我绕到你的桶后面。
lines.en: I circle around behind your bucket.

lines.zh: 水里全是末地石，你分不清。
lines.en: The water is full of End stone; you can't tell.

lines.zh: 这一路，我只跟着味道。
lines.en: All this way, I have only followed the smell.

lines.zh: 你转身，正好看见我的背。
lines.en: You turn and see exactly my back.

lines.zh: 再等一会，我就咬钩。
lines.en: Wait a moment more, and I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我们三面包过来，你没处退。
lines.en: We close in from three sides; nowhere to retreat.

lines.zh: 石头撞石头，你的腿先疼。
lines.en: Stone strikes stone, and your leg hurts first.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，像被镐敲了一下。
lines.en: My bite feels like a tap from a pickaxe.

lines.zh: 苔藓底下全是硬骨。
lines.en: Under the moss is nothing but hard bone.

lines.zh: 你举盾一挡，小臂立刻发麻。
lines.en: You raise your shield; your forearm numbs.

lines.zh: 五点生命，撞起来不含糊。
lines.en: Five points of health, and I hit hard.

lines.zh: 水里闷响，那是我的牙。
lines.en: That dull thud underwater is my teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬完就沉，不留在原地。
lines.en: I bite, then sink away from the spot.

lines.zh: 你退后，我追了一小段。
lines.en: You back off, and I chase a short way.

lines.zh: 石头也会生气，只是很慢。
lines.en: Stone can get angry too, just slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下，够你记到末地之外。
lines.en: This one will stay with you past the End.

lines.zh: 末地的水里，我又沉了下来。
lines.en: In the End's water, I settle down again.

lines.zh: 三到五条一起出现，像落石。
lines.en: Three to five of us appear like falling stones.

lines.zh: 橙色苔藓先亮，我才成形。
lines.en: The orange moss glows first, then I take shape.

lines.zh: 虚空边上，多了一块会动的岩。
lines.en: At the void's rim, another moving rock appears.

lines.zh: 这次我生在末地石旁边。
lines.en: This time I spawned by the End stone.

lines.zh: 水里没什么可看的，除了我们。
lines.en: Nothing worth seeing in this water but us.

lines.zh: 我从岩层里分出来，落了水。
lines.en: I split off from the rock layer and fell in.

lines.zh: 同伴已经在等了。
lines.en: My companions are already waiting.

lines.zh: 末地的水一动，就有人来。
lines.en: When the End's water stirs, something arrives.

lines.zh: 普通得很，但也不少。
lines.en: Nothing special, but there are plenty of us.

lines.zh: 火烤岩鱼，苔藓先焦，再轮到我。
lines.en: Fire chars the moss first, then cooks me.

lines.zh: 从水面摔下来，我磕掉一块。
lines.en: I hit the bottom and knock off a piece.

lines.zh: 石头鱼在水里，怎么淹？
lines.en: How does a stone fish drown in water?

lines.zh: 炸开我一块，里面还是石头。
lines.en: Blast a piece off and it's stone inside too.

lines.zh: 箭撞上我，扎不进，弹开了。
lines.en: The arrow hits me, can't pierce, and bounces off.

lines.zh: 魔法在我身上滑下去，像水滴。
lines.en: Magic slides off me like a water drop.

lines.zh: 石头也会饿，只是饿得慢。
lines.en: Stone gets hungry too, only slowly.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的苔藓全立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my moss stands on end.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走水，我的石头开始轻。
lines.en: The void drains the water and my stone lightens.
